title: Refactor CI: split lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache & parallelism, bump actions/node
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Context and motivation:
- Over time our single large CI workflow accumulated multiple responsibilities: linting, unit/integration tests, release automation, and long-running matrix builds. This caused frequent cache misses, duplicated work across jobs, and brittle reruns.
- Goal: split responsibilities into focused workflows (lint, test, release) so each can be optimized independently, improve cache reuse across matrix jobs, and reduce wall-clock time for common changes (docs, small packages).
What this PR does (summary):
- Split the monolithic .github/workflows/ci.yml into three focused workflows: ci-lint.yml, ci-test.yml, release.yml.
- Introduces a small actions helper (.github/actions/cache-key) to produce stable cache keys for node_modules and build artifacts to reduce misses across matrix and reruns.
- Parallelizes cache restore/save steps to avoid serial lock contention when multiple matrix jobs run.
- Standardizes NodeJS version to 20 across CI and bumps common actions to latest stable (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4).
- Adds a lightweight fast-check for lint-only PRs to short-circuit full test matrix when only docs or README changes are detected.
- Improves workflow hygiene: clearer job names, explicit permissions minimalization, and consistent environment variables for cache namespaces.
Checklist:
- [x] Split workflows with clear triggers (push/pull_request for lint/test, release on tag + manual dispatch)
- [x] Implement stable cache key helper and integrate with matrix jobs
- [x] Bump actions and Node versions, validate locally and in CI
- [x] Add short-circuit path for docs/README-only PRs
- [x] Update internal docs (CONTRIBUTING.md CI section)
Commits (high-level):
- chore(ci): add ci-lint workflow and cache-key action (adds 6 files)
- feat(ci): split test workflow and parallelize cache operations (changes matrix definitions)
- chore(ci): bump actions and node to 20, update workflow permissions
- docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md with new workflow descriptions
Changed areas (high-level):
- .github/workflows/ci-lint.yml (new)
- .github/workflows/ci-test.yml (new)
- .github/workflows/release.yml (new)
- .github/actions/cache-key/action.yml (new helper action)
- tools/ci/cache-utils.ts (helper utilities used by GH actions)
- package.json / package-lock.json (devDeps bump for ESLint, jest)
- CONTRIBUTING.md (CI section updated)
Review convo (summary):
- Jared: asked to confirm cache key stability across matrix permutations and suggested adding repository + hash-of-package-lock to key.
- Author reply: implemented a composite key (repo-name + node-version + lockfile-hash + matrix-target) and added tests for cache-key in tools/ci.
- Monica: requested that release workflow keep a dry-run path and that tags continue to trigger existing release pipeline semantics.
- Author reply: release.yml kept the existing release-step semantics; added manual dispatch and a dry-run boolean to the workflow.
- Evan: observed a transient windows runner cache lock in initial run; recommended making cache steps best-effort and not fail the job on cache save conflict.
- Author reply: adjusted cache save to be non-blocking (catch errors) and added logging to surface conflicts without hard failing tests.
CI summary and notes:
- Initial run (first push) saw two failing matrix jobs caused by an outdated setup-node pinned in a secondary repo reference. Fixed by bumping to actions/setup-node@v4 in the workflow templates.
- Rerun: all checks passed. Full check matrix executed on PR and took ~22 minutes raw (previously ~38m on similar change).
- Verified short-circuit on docs-only change: lint job runs only (~3 minutes).
Merge outcome: Squash-merged after approvals from Jared/Monica and green CI.
Related: ENG-3245 (CI refactor), ENG-3290 (release automation hygiene).

Aisha Patel: Updated to composite key (repo + node + lockfile hash + matrix target). Added unit tests for cache key generation.
Monica Ruiz: Release workflow should preserve tag-trigger behavior and provide dry-run for safety.
Aisha Patel: Preserved tag trigger and added manual dispatch + dry-run flag. Documented behavior in CONTRIBUTING.md.
Evan Zhang: Observed transient cache save conflicts on Windows runners; prefer best-effort save so tests don't fail.
Aisha Patel: Cache save now best-effort with explicit logging of conflicts; job no longer fails on cache save error.
Jared Kim: LGTM after fixes - approving.
release_notes: Refactor CI: split workflows for lint/test/release, improve cache key stability and parallelism, bump Node/actions. Result: faster PR feedback, fewer cache misses, and clearer release automation.
